summary: Luke Badiali reviewed marketing with Paul and Rebecca. Thornbury produces little content and has no campaign rhythm. We agreed a supplier inflation campaign aimed at PE-backed CFOs and a case study programme.

discussion.keyPoints: Five articles in the last year, none aimed at CFOs. Paul has strong views on supplier inflation that he shares in meetings but never publishes.
Only the logistics client has signed off figures so far. Rebecca thinks two more clients may agree.
Nobody tracks where enquiries come from beyond 'Paul knows them'.

recommendations.recommendation: Run a 'Supplier inflation index' campaign each quarter, sent to 300 PE portfolio CFOs.
Publish 3 finance-verified case studies by the end of the quarter.
Paul writes one LinkedIn article a month on supplier inflation and covenant pressure.
Track every new opportunity's source in Pipedrive and report campaign-sourced pipeline monthly.

actions.action: Draft the first Supplier inflation index

nextFocus: Partnerships with PE houses and adjacent advisers.
nextPreparation: Paul to list advisers who have introduced work in the past three years.

tests.question: How often will Paul publish on LinkedIn?
